target_customer: Individuals and small teams who want AI agents to design, launch and sell a product or small business
problem: Starting and running a business needs many roles at once. Pazi packages AI agents as role holders that plan, execute and report progress against a goal.
business_model: Freemium SaaS for AI agent workflows (pricing tiers not shown on site)
product_category: AI agent platform for building and running businesses (formerly AI app builder Pythagora with the open source GPT Pilot)

founders.name: Zvonimir Sabljić
previous_startups: AWW (A Web Whiteboard), acquired by Miro in 2021
founders.background_notes: YC page credits him with GPT Pilot and an open source automated testing repo.

founders.name: Leon Ostrež
prior_employers: Faze Clan (led tech team before its public listing)

technical_complexity.rationale: Orchestrating LLM agents across multi-step tasks and integrations was standard engineering with hard reliability problems in 2024. The team already had a widely used open source coding agent (GPT Pilot).

defensibility.rationale: Agent frameworks were easy to copy and depended on third party models. The open source community around GPT Pilot gave some distribution.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Model labs and coding agent companies kept shipping agent products. No source found on a direct takeover of Pazi.

market_need_then: Strong interest in autonomous AI agents and AI app builders in 2024, shown by GPT Pilot's open source star count reported on the YC page and by the seed round coverage.

branding.domain_note: pazi.ai is the current site; earlier company name was Pythagora.

identity.voice_and_tone: Action oriented tagline: Make the thing. Sell the thing.

rebrands.why: Not stated; the company moved from an AI app builder to autonomous company agents.

branding.community_and_virality: The GPT Pilot open source project has tens of thousands of GitHub stars per the YC page, which predates the Pazi name. The site shows a Discord and user social posts.

brand_strength.rationale: Little press about the Pazi brand itself; the rebrand from a recognized open source name is not explained and may have cost awareness.

pivots.from: GPT Pilot / Pythagora AI app builder
pivots.to: Pazi, platform for autonomous companies run by agents
pivots.why: Not stated in sources found; date of the rename is not public in sources opened.

outcome_analysis: Pazi is active with a 2024 seed of 4 million dollars and no reported exit or shutdown. The team brought open source credibility from GPT Pilot and a prior acquired startup, and rode the 2024 agent wave. The rename and shift from a coding agent to company agents is unexplained, and the product faces fast moving model labs, so its outcome is still open.
notes: YC page lists founded year 2026, which looks wrong. Aggregators say Pythagora was founded 2023, left null. Investor lists differ across outlets and one source names 500 Global as lead. Competitor searches returned only undated comparison sites, so the list is empty. Branding search found nothing on the name origin.
